front: Conceals your armor and sheathed weapons, either invisible or disguised as ordinary clothes. It doesn't change your appearance otherwise.
back:
Hides worn armor and sheathed weapons.
When you wield an affected weapon it becomes obvious and unaffected until sheathed for at least 1 minute.
A creature can Seek to disbelieve the illusion (DC 15), and may do so without spending an action each time it hits you with an attack.
